themes.label: UK-listed franchises broken up or taken private
themes.note: EasyJet's Castlelake take-private (ezj-castlelake-takeover) and ITV's sale of its broadcast arm to Comcast's Sky (itv-sky-me-sale) remain the two active UK restructurings.

themes.label: Public-to-private buyout offers on listed companies
themes.note: Sponsors and insiders keep taking listed names private: Castlelake's accepted EasyJet buyout (ezj-castlelake-takeover), Steel Partners' competing $16.75/share cash offer for InMode (inmd-steel-partners-buyout), and now early PE interest in Qiagen from EQT, Advent, and KKR (qgen-pe-consortium-takeover-interest).

themes.label: Semiconductor deals stay active
themes.note: Chip-sector partnerships and consolidation stay live — the Intel-Apple foundry partnership (intc-aapl-partnership) and the rumored AMD bid for Lattice (amd-xlnx-followup-acquisition).

themes.label: Defense primes racing for undersea/anti-submarine-warfare tech
themes.note: Thales's control deal for mine-clearing drone maker Exail (ho-exail-acquisition) and Lockheed's $3.45bn purchase of sonar specialist Ultra Maritime (lmt-ultra-maritime-acquisition) landed within days of each other.
